stage.name: Eye For an Eye
stage.description:
The author of this story cares not where the blood flows, only that there be a bloodbath.
Choose a foe and fight. Losing will not deduct Life Points. Defeating a tougher foe within the given time grants a better reward
stage.source: mode level file; no stage_table row

arc_screenguard_captain.name: Arc Screenguard Captain
arc_screenguard_captain.flavourText: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. They don't even need their equipment to hold the frontline and prevent the enemy's advance.
abilities: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

ergate_leader.name: Ergate Leader
ergate_leader.flavourText: An engineer that specializes in sabotage, almost never seen wielding weapons. Though unarmed, they utilize their agility and cunning to slip through defenses in order to sabotage mechanical and electrical equipment. They are more difficult to deal with than normal Ergates.
abilities: Cannot be blocked.

lakeside_volunteer.name: Lakeside Volunteer
lakeside_volunteer.flavourText: An amateur lifeguard doing nothing in particular. Because there really was nobody in need of saving, he instead decided to take up boxing, and unexpectedly had quite the talent for it.
abilities: Upon dropping below half HP for the first time, gains 100% Physical Dodge for a period of time

tiacauh_fanatic.name: Tiacauh Fanatic
tiacauh_fanatic.flavourText: A fervent Tiacauh warrior with very fast attack speed. Though each strike is not particularly powerful, those caught off guard will be quickly subdued by a rain of blows.
abilities: Every attack reduces the enemy's DEF

lurker.name: Lurker
lurker.flavourText: One of Reunion's special soldiers. They move swiftly and stealthily, making it almost impossible to detect them before they engage in combat. Therefore, teamwork is needed in order to defeat them.
abilities: Invisible

brassrust_olmer_ingra.name: 'Brassrust' Olmer Ingra
brassrust_olmer_ingra.flavourText: The great knight known as the 'Butcher of the Field'! Convicted several times for acts of brutality, avoided trial several times thanks to corporate contributions! Youngest son of the Ingra family, an ancient knightly lineage! A ruthless fighter who gets stronger with each battle! Olmerrrrrr Ingraaaaaaa!
abilities: Each time an enemy is defeated, gains ATK and ASPD, stacking up to 10 times.

left_hand_tytus_topola.name: 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola
left_hand_tytus_topola.flavourText: His nose is high as the sun, and he's almost as terrifyingly strong, if much, much colder. And look how many fans have lined up for him! He's 'Left-hand' Tytus Topola! He weakens his enemies' resolve, crushes their spirit, sneering down at them as they fall to their knees in surrender. That's a Left-handed victory!
abilities: Significantly decreases ATK of the unit with the highest ATK for a period of time
Rebirth

the_brigadier.name: 'The Brigadier'
the_brigadier.flavourText: 'The Brigadier,' a senior Dublinn officer and captain of the Redsteel Guard. With a blade tempered by the flames of war, he cuts through the chaos to find the order he has set his mind on.
abilities: Ignites Reeds upon passing by them
After several attacks, unleashes 5 powerful consecutive slashes at the target

arc_frontliner.name: Arc Frontliner
arc_frontliner.flavourText: Deadly soldiers from an experimental unit outfitted with cutting-edge equipment. However, the instability of their gear is their weak spot.
abilities: Loses HP proportional to distance moved when shifted

crying_thief.name: Crying Thief
crying_thief.flavourText: A Perro who left his family to seek out a new life... but all that people know is that he is always weeping.
abilities: Invisible
Attacks Stun the target

duck_lord.name: Duck Lord
duck_lord.flavourText: A famous Columbian investor, entrepreneur, and master of 'Duck Power.' Out of the public eye, enjoys kicking back with others...
abilities: Cannot be blocked.
Gains significantly increased Movement Speed after being attacked

enraged_possessed_leader.name: Enraged Possessed Leader
enraged_possessed_leader.flavourText: An enemy combatant who has completely given in to primal madness as their lifeforce is consumed. The infection has penetrated their bone marrow, and their death-defying aggression breaks the bounds of reason. The appearance of such an aberration on the battlefield is almost beyond imagination.
abilities: Will gradually lose HP over time

enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.name: Enraged Tombkeeper Grotesque
enraged_tombkeeper_grotesque.flavourText: A special Arts creation from the Dublinn forces, created by their leader Mandragora. According to Mandragora, back when she was studying Originium Arts in an outskirts cemetery, the Tombkeeper Grotesque was her first companion. Its outer appearance has gone through many redesigns, with the latest being based off a Sarkaz from an ancient bloodline. This series of Tombkeepers embodies Mandragora's fury towards Victoria.
abilities: After first defeat, temporarily transforms into a stone statue with extremely high DEF, then revives as an aerial unit
Refraction

fatty.name: Fatty
fatty.flavourText: Duck Lord's associate and apprentice, an opportunist with a slick tongue. Frequently appears on dubious TV shows, preaching about how he cares little for losses or gains, as they are part of the natural money-making process.
abilities: Always faces the direction with the most Operators.
Takes 80% less Physical/Arts damage from the front.

fortuna_fallen_angel.name: Fortuna, Fallen Angel
fortuna_fallen_angel.flavourText: A fallen Sankta girl, the innocent and ignorant Fortuna. With her dimmed halo and black horns, paradise has closed its doors on her. What has actually changed, and what has not?
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and deal a large amount of Physical damage. Ammo capacity: 6
Has a chance to miss ranged attacks

gopnik.name: Gopnik
gopnik.flavourText: The Ursus security guard hired by Duck Lord. Powerful, but not very smart. Mainly responsible for carrying luggage for Duck Lord.

hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.name: Hateful Avenger
hateful_avenger_enemy_1025_reveng_2.flavourText: An unidentified combatant who attacks using unconventional methods, more dangerous than a normal Avenger. Equipped with a special weapon, they are known to change their attack patterns during combat, making them difficult to defend against. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%

lost_hovercraft.name: Lost Hovercraft
lost_hovercraft.flavourText: An automated thought collector built by a lost Kazdelian empire. Despite its ability to hover for extended periods, its built-in package protection mechanism compels it to land immediately upon encountering interference.
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Steals Originium Ingots upon entering the Objective.

mead_grade_waker_upper.name: Mead-Grade Waker-Upper
mead_grade_waker_upper.flavourText: A powerful machine that sends chills across the beach with its might, providing a complimentary water cannon service for drunkards by the lake. The only downside being that it has no way of actually identifying who is drunk.
abilities: Upon taking damage for the first time, gains significantly increased ASPD and Movement Speed for a period of time

oren_legatus.name: Oren, Legatus
oren_legatus.flavourText: The Legatus who stands head and shoulders above the rest, acting on his own principles. Preferring hit-and-run tactics to direct confrontations, he tries to deceive his opponents by sealing off their moves.
abilities: While this unit is holding Ammo, attacks become long-ranged and prevent the target from attacking or healing for a period of time. Ammo Capacity: 1
Deals additional Arts damage to 'Gelato Stops'

originiutant_enemy_1134_diamd.name: Originiutant
originiutant_enemy_1134_diamd.flavourText: An Originiutant mutant that was weaponized for some purpose. Possesses an incredibly tough outer shell.

pugilist_prisoner.name: Pugilist Prisoner
pugilist_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate who puts his trust in his fists. ——In reality, the metal chains on his wrists are doing most of the work.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and attacks ignore a certain portion of the target's DEF

r_31a_heavy_power_armor.name: R-31a Heavy Power Armor
r_31a_heavy_power_armor.flavourText: A model that appeared around half a year ago among some mercenary groups, its performance is on par with mass-produced military models from five years ago. Technology is unregulated, so Columbians continue to seek greater efficiency within the bounds of the law.
abilities: [Overload] Continuously deals Physical damage to the target proportional to the unit's ATK, andStuns the target

sarkaz_caster_leader.name: Sarkaz Caster Leader
sarkaz_caster_leader.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz, more dangerous than a normal Sarkaz Caster. They use complex Arts to attack. Proceed with caution.
abilities: Uses chains to paralyze allied Operators.

sarkaz_greatswordsman.name: Sarkaz Greatswordsman
sarkaz_greatswordsman.flavourText: A mercenary from Sarkaz. The Originium inside them has boosted their physical abilities, allowing them to wield larger weapons with ease and withstand more damage.

shattered_champion.name: Shattered Champion
shattered_champion.flavourText: Once an honorable warrior of the Treescar tribe, now a part of the demons' vanguard, together with their fallen chief.

the_candle_knight_viviana.name: The Candle Knight Viviana
the_candle_knight_viviana.flavourText: The Candle Knight, Viviana Droste. Words fail to describe her beauty, her brilliant eyes alone are enchanting enough. Tonight, the marigolds bloom for her.
abilities: [Glimmering Touch] After charging for some time, deals a large amount of Arts damage to a target and all surrounding units
While charging, loses Invisibility

tiacauh_champion.name: Tiacauh Champion
tiacauh_champion.flavourText: An incredibly formidable Tiacauh warrior, with the qualifications to become a Warchief. These warriors harbor great pride in their combat abilities, and live for the thrill of the duel no matter where they are. Their single-mindedness allows them to shrug off all outside interference.
abilities: When blocked, this unit will only receive damage from the unit blocking it, and the DEF of both units is decreased.

hateful_avenger_enemy_1539_reid.name: 'Hateful Avenger'
hateful_avenger_enemy_1539_reid.flavourText: A Reunion squad leader you've previously faced, who attacks with an impressive searing blade. The formidable foe you defeated in the Area 59 Ruins appears before you once again, unsheathing the flames of vengeance.
abilities: Gains significantly increased ATK when HP is under 50%
[Charge] Locks onto a target within range on the path ahead, and gains greatly increased Movement Speed for a period of time
Revives after being defeated for the first time, recovering half its HP

jesselton_williams.name: Jesselton Williams
jesselton_williams.flavourText: Jesselton Williams, a killer who infiltrated the prison disguised as a jailer. Very particular in both speech and action, he remains graceful even in the midst of battle.
abilities: Jailer Form
RES is greatly increased
Attacks become ranged and deal Arts damage, and no longer attacks Imprisonment Devices
Can Stun multiple targets
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Killer Form
Killer Form
Frees all imprisoned enemies when entering Killer Form
Gains significantly increased DEF
Uses melee Physical attacks that ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF

mon2tr.name: Mon2tr
mon2tr.flavourText: The mediator's guardian and companion. It will fail, and they will succeed.
abilities: Upon switching positions or death, deals Physical damage to all nearby allied units and stuns them for several seconds.

sarkaz_centurion.name: Sarkaz Centurion
sarkaz_centurion.flavourText: One of Reunion's squad leaders who also serves as a Sarkaz mercenary. He leads a group of Sarkaz mercenaries to fight on the front lines. Based upon the limited intel available, he is extremely tight-lipped, thus making it unlikely to get any information from him.
abilities: Attacks two targets simultaneously.

devices.description: Can deploy both Melee and Ranged Operators
